versions.changelog: v1.2.0 - 添加语音模板功能，预设常用语

- Initial release of Feishu Voice Skill.
- Send real voice notes (not file attachments) to Feishu users, playable with one click.
- Integrate NoizAI TTS for high-quality, emotion-controllable speech synthesis.
- Automatically convert audio to OPUS format for compatibility with Feishu voice messages.
- Simple one-command script for sending text as voice; supports parameter customization.
- Includes usage instructions, common scenarios, troubleshooting, and examples.
